positions.title: CEO
positions.description:
Designed and implemented algorithms to predict to what degree each user wants to read items pulled regularly from over 10,000 RSS feeds, and how each individual user would categorize those items.

Implemented a high performance server in C to determine each user's front page items in real time over 25 times faster than a traditional database solution.
